rationale: The signal establishes the order of two witnessed assembly events for the same packet. It does not settle the complete order of every textual revision, since the ledger excludes earlier composition and unobserved rearrangements. Reliable custody does not fill those evidentiary gaps.

signal_basis.exact_text: Two reliable witnesses record the identified opening leaves being attached to D-17 on 4 June.
A continuous safeguarded chain connects that packet to a witnessed binding of D-17 on 7 June.
The ledger covers only these events and provides no record of earlier composition, unobserved rearrangements or authorial intention.
